description-zh: 基于优先队列的 Prim 算法计算 MST 权值
description-en: Prim's algorithm using priority queue to compute MST weight
code:
import java.util.*;
public long primMST(int n, List<List<int[]>> adj){ boolean[] vis=new boolean[n]; long ans=0; int cnt=0; PriorityQueue<long[]> pq=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a->a[0])); pq.add(new long[]{0,0}); while(!pq.isEmpty()&&cnt<n){ long[] cur=pq.poll(); int u=(int)cur[1]; if(vis[u]) continue; vis[u]=true; ans+=cur[0]; cnt++; for(int[] e: adj.get(u)) if(!vis[e[0]]) pq.add(new long[]{e[1], e[0]}); } return cnt==n? ans: -1; }

description-zh: 从多个源点同时出发的最短步数 BFS
description-en: BFS shortest steps from multiple sources
code:
import java.util.*;
public int[] multiSourceBFS(int n, List<List<Integer>> adj, int[] sources){ int[] dist=new int[n]; Arrays.fill(dist,-1); ArrayDeque<Integer> q=new ArrayDeque<>(); for(int s: sources){ dist[s]=0; q.add(s);} while(!q.isEmpty()){ int u=q.poll(); for(int v: adj.get(u)) if(dist[v]==-1){ dist[v]=dist[u]+1; q.add(v);} } return dist; }

name-zh: 最长回文子串(中心扩展)
description-zh: 中心扩展法求最长回文子串
description-en: Center expansion to get longest palindromic substring
code:
public String longestPalindrome(String s){ if(s==null||s.isEmpty()) return ""; int n=s.length(), L=0,R=0; for(int c=0;c<n;c++){ int[] a=expand(s,c,c), b=expand(s,c,c+1); if(a[1]-a[0] > R-L){ L=a[0]; R=a[1]; } if(b[1]-b[0] > R-L){ L=b[0]; R=b[1]; } } return s.substring(L,R+1); }
private int[] expand(String s,int l,int r){ int n=s.length(); while(l>=0&&r<n&&s.charAt(l)==s.charAt(r)){ l--; r++; } return new int[]{l+1,r-1}; }

description-zh: 使用位掩码生成集合的所有子集
description-en: Generate all subsets using bitmask
code:
import java.util.*;
public List<List<Integer>> subsetsBitmask(int[] a){ int n=a.length; List<List<Integer>> out=new ArrayList<>(); for(int m=0;m<(1<<n);m++){ List<Integer> cur=new ArrayList<>(); for(int i=0;i<n;i++) if((m&(1<<i))!=0) cur.add(a[i]); out.add(cur);} return out; }

description-zh: 双模数滚动哈希骨架，便于子串比较
description-en: Double-mod rolling hash skeleton for substring hashing
code: class DoubleHash { long MOD1=1_000_000_007L, MOD2=1_000_000_009L, B=131L; long[] p1,p2,h1,h2; int n; DoubleHash(String s){ n=s.length(); p1=new long[n+1]; p2=new long[n+1]; h1=new long[n+1]; h2=new long[n+1]; p1[0]=p2[0]=1; for(int i=0;i<n;i++){ p1[i+1]=(p1[i]*B)%MOD1; p2[i+1]=(p2[i]*B)%MOD2; h1[i+1]=(h1[i]*B + s.charAt(i))%MOD1; h2[i+1]=(h2[i]*B + s.charAt(i))%MOD2; } } long[] get(int l,int r){ long x1=(h1[r+1]-h1[l]*p1[r-l+1])%MOD1; if(x1<0) x1+=MOD1; long x2=(h2[r+1]-h2[l]*p2[r-l+1])%MOD2; if(x2<0) x2+=MOD2; return new long[]{x1,x2}; } }

description-zh: 带路径压缩与按秩合并的并查集，支持find/unite/same
description-en: Union-Find with path compression and union by rank; supports find/unite/same
code: class DSU { int[] p, r; DSU(int n){ p=new int[n]; r=new int[n]; for(int i=0;i<n;i++) p[i]=i; } int find(int x){ return p[x]==x?x:(p[x]=find(p[x])); } boolean unite(int a,int b){ a=find(a); b=find(b); if(a==b) return false; if(r[a]<r[b]){int t=a;a=b;b=t;} p[b]=a; if(r[a]==r[b]) r[a]++; return true; } boolean same(int a,int b){ return find(a)==find(b); } }

description-zh: 支持前缀和与单点修改，O(log n) 操作
description-en: Support prefix sums and point updates in O(log n)
code: class Fenwick { int n; long[] t; Fenwick(int n){ this.n=n; t=new long[n+1]; } void add(int i,int delta){ for(i+=1;i<=n;i+=i&-i) t[i]+=delta; } long sum(int i){ long s=0; for(i+=1;i>0;i-=i&-i) s+=t[i]; return s; } long rangeSum(int l,int r){ if(r<l) return 0; return sum(r)-sum(l-1); } }

description-zh: 支持O(1)获取最小值的栈，双栈实现
description-en: Stack with O(1) getMin implemented by two stacks
code: import java.util.*; class MinStack { Deque<Integer> s=new ArrayDeque<>(), mn=new ArrayDeque<>(); void push(int x){ s.push(x); if(mn.isEmpty()||x<=mn.peek()) mn.push(x); } int pop(){ int x=s.pop(); if(x==mn.peek()) mn.pop(); return x; } int top(){ return s.peek(); } int getMin(){ return mn.peek(); } boolean isEmpty(){ return s.isEmpty(); } }
